intro.heading: Experience the Galápagos With Celebrity
paragraphs: Celebrity Galápagos Cruises offer an intimate expedition experience in one of the world's most extraordinary wildlife destinations.

The centerpiece of Celebrity's Galápagos program is Celebrity Flora, a 100-guest, all-suite mega-yacht purpose-built for the Galápagos Islands. The experience combines guided exploration with Galápagos National Park-certified naturalists, small-group excursions, wildlife encounters, snorkeling and comfortable suite accommodations.

Celebrity's current Galápagos program includes 7-night cruises, along with longer 10-, 11- and 16-night vacation packages that can combine the islands with Quito and, on selected journeys, Peru and Machu Picchu.
intro.quickAnswer: Celebrity Galápagos Cruises are all-inclusive expedition-style vacations centered on Celebrity Flora, with 7-night Galápagos cruises, twice-daily naturalist-led excursions, wildlife encounters, meals, drinks, Wi-Fi, gratuities, park fees and expedition equipment included. Longer packages can add Quito and South American destinations such as Lima, Cusco and Machu Picchu.

innerLoop.summary: The Inner Loop itinerary explores a unique combination of central and western islands. A current 7-night Inner Loop itinerary includes Egas Port, Rábida Island, Elizabeth Bay, Tagus Cove, Sullivan Bay, Bartolomé and Las Bachas.

outerLoop.summary: The Outer Loop offers a distinctive wildlife and landscape combination. Selected visitor sites include Gardner Bay, Punta Suárez, Cormorant Point, Post Office Bay, Moreno Point, Urvina Bay, Espinoza Point and Vicente Roca Point.

seasonsTable.title: Celebrity Galápagos Cruise Seasons & Weather Overview
seasonsTable.description: The Galápagos is a year-round wildlife destination. Conditions, water temperatures, and animal behaviors vary distinctly by season:
rows: Warmer air & water temperatures, calmer seas, lush green island landscapes, excellent swimming & snorkeling visibility.
Cooler temperatures, nutrient-rich Humboldt current bringing abundant marine life, active ocean ecosystems, superb wildlife photography.
Wildlife activity occurs continuously across all months; giant tortoises, sea lions, boobies, and marine iguanas are present throughout the year.

faqs.question: 1. What are Celebrity Galápagos Cruises?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Galápagos Cruises are luxury expedition-style cruises centered on Celebrity Flora, an all-suite 100-guest ship designed specifically for the Galápagos.

faqs.question: 2. What ship does Celebrity use in the Galápagos?
faqs.answer: Celebrity's flagship Galápagos ship is Celebrity Flora, a purpose-built, all-suite mega-yacht designed for the islands.

faqs.question: 3. How many guests does Celebrity Flora accommodate?
4. How long are Celebrity Galápagos Cruises?
faqs.answer: The core Galápagos cruise is 7 nights. Celebrity also offers longer 10-, 11- and 16-night vacation packages combining the cruise with mainland Ecuador and, on selected itineraries, Peru.

faqs.question: 5. What is included on Celebrity Galápagos Cruises?
faqs.answer: The 7-night cruise includes accommodations, meals, beverages, Wi-Fi, room service, naturalist programs, expedition equipment, gratuities, Galápagos National Park admission, Tourist Card fees and Baltra transfers.

faqs.question: 6. Are excursions included on Celebrity Galápagos Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity includes twice-daily Galápagos National Park-certified naturalist-guided excursions.

faqs.question: 7. What wildlife can I see on a Celebrity Galápagos Cruise?
faqs.answer: Depending on the itinerary and conditions, travelers may see giant tortoises, marine iguanas, sea lions, Galápagos penguins, blue-footed boobies, frigatebirds, sea turtles and other endemic wildlife.

faqs.question: 8. What is the Celebrity Galápagos Inner Loop?
faqs.answer: The Inner Loop is a Celebrity Flora itinerary visiting a selection of central and western Galápagos destinations. A current itinerary includes Santiago, Rábida, Isabela, Bartolomé and Santa Cruz.

faqs.question: 9. What is the Celebrity Galápagos Outer Loop?
faqs.answer: The Outer Loop is an alternative itinerary featuring destinations such as Española, Floreana, Isabela, Fernandina and Santa Cruz.

faqs.question: 10. Does Celebrity include snorkeling equipment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity provides complimentary snorkeling equipment, mini-wetsuits, binoculars and walking sticks for the duration of the cruise.

faqs.question: 11. Are drinks included on Celebrity Galápagos Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity includes beverages onboard, including select wines, sparkling wine, spirits, soft drinks, bottled water, coffee and tea.

faqs.question: 12. Is Wi-Fi included on Celebrity Flora?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary internet access is included, and Celebrity promotes unlimited Wi-Fi as part of its Galápagos experience.

faqs.question: 13. Does Celebrity offer Galápagos and Machu Picchu packages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected 16-night packages combine the Galápagos with Machu Picchu and other South American experiences.

faqs.question: 14. Does Celebrity include Quito before the Galápagos cruise?
faqs.answer: Celebrity's 10-, 11- and 16-night packages include a pre-cruise Quito stay, with hotel accommodation, transfers, a guided Quito tour and transportation to Baltra.

faqs.question: 15. Are Celebrity Galápagos Cruises worth it?
faqs.answer: They can be an excellent choice for travelers who want an all-inclusive luxury expedition experience, with an all-suite ship, twice-daily naturalist-led excursions, wildlife encounters and many major expedition costs included.
